I was able to explain my concept in plain English text and within 10mins it built a completely functional app for me. It includes iOS Simulator with various sizes, OS of iPhones and iPads to test out my app. I was able to make edits to the App via simple intuitive commands. If you have an app idea and no coding background, LastApp is absolutely the way to go. Highly recommended!

title: Blown Away by How Fast and Easy This Is
body: This app is incredible. You just describe what you want and it builds a full iOS app, Android app, and web app in minutes. Everything you’d expect is already included, like login, analytics, and a clean structure. You can do all of it right from your phone, which still amazes me. As an engineer, I also love that you get full source code, so you can customize anything you want. The apps it generates look completely professional too. The iOS version feels exactly like a real iOS app, with proper flows and screens, and the Android version looks and behaves like a true Android app. It really matches each system’s style perfectly. The best part is how fast you get something you can actually use and fine-tune. Within minutes you’re tapping through the app, adjusting the UX, and seeing changes right away. Getting a working app this quickly is honestly unbelievable!
